permit_name: Fill Permit or Floodplain Alteration Permit

explanations.trigger_explanation: Dallas likely requires a fill permit and/or floodplain alteration permit for development in mapped 100-year floodplain or similar flood-risk areas.

advisories: Additional review is recommended if the work also requires FEMA map revision sequencing or federal water permits.
notes: Tier 2: the current city application form directly verifies permit names and trigger context; technical study requirements vary by project.
